description:
MCP server that gives AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) real interactive terminal sessions — REPLs, SSH, databases, Docker, and any interactive CLI with clean output via xterm-headless, smart completion detection, and 7-layer security.
   Install: npx -y mcp-interactive-terminal
